verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents running gstack itself headlessly or in a CI pipeline, such as a non-interactive invocation mode, CI configuration, or exit-code semantics for automation. The headless Chromium daemon ($B) is an adjacent browser-automation feature. /autoplan's auto-decisions and the GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE flag reduce prompting but do not establish headless or CI execution. Any headless operation would depend on host-agent capabilities, which earn no credit here.
